feedback: Iteration 6 (entityR2B, 72.91) is the evidence for this step. Iteration 4 (entityR2B, 124.20) and iteration 5 show that inertia drives slalom line loss, and inertia is now held at the iteration-1 values, so the controller is the variable to test. I cannot state an outcome for the current candidate, which has not raced. Next steps depend on the next race. If slalom line loss falls to 0.1 or below and oval progress recovers toward 0.4 or more, hold wheel_track 0.10 and kp 2.5. If slalom line loss stays at 0.2 or higher even at kp 2.5, the narrow track itself is the problem, so return to wheel_track 0.12, as you proposed. If line loss is near 0.1 but max_error still sits at about 0.063 m, the remaining limit is gain balance and not geometry, and I will say so in the next request; the mass step in the requested changes is then the only geometry lever with evidence behind it.
